hotel.name: The Grand Azure & Grand Aurel Resort & Spa
hotel.check_out_time: 11:00 AM (standard check-out is at noon for Grand Aurel; late check-out until 4 PM available for $95)
hotel.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours prior to check-in (3:00 PM local time). Cancellations made within 48 hours of arrival incur a fee equal to the first night's room rate plus tax.
hotel.breakfast_policy: Our breakfast buffet is served in the Grand Salon from 7 to 11 AM (weekends until 11:30 AM). Continental, cooked-to-order, and plant-based options are available. Room service breakfast begins at 6 AM. For Azure Bay dining room, breakfast is served 7:00 AM - 10:30 AM ($25/adult, complimentary for Executive Harbor Suites and Two-Bedroom Family Villas).
hotel.meal_policy: Lunch and dinner are available à la carte at our dining venues or via 24-hour room service. Breakfast is served 6–11 AM, lunch 12–3 PM, and dinner from 6 PM through midnight. After midnight, our late-night menu features light fare and classic cocktails.

amenities.name: Rooftop Heated Infinity Pool
amenities.description: The heated rooftop infinity pool is open from 7 AM to 10 PM for guests. Cabanas may be reserved in advance. Poolside service for drinks and light bites runs 10 AM to 8 PM.

amenities.name: 24/7 Fitness Centre
amenities.description: The fitness centre is open 24 hours with keycard access. It features Technogym equipment, a cycling studio, and Peloton bikes. Personal training sessions can be arranged at €120/hour.

amenities.name: The Aurel Spa
amenities.description: The Aurel Spa is open daily from 8 AM to 9 PM. We offer signature treatments including the Grand Hammam ritual (90 min, $280), deep tissue massage (60 min, $195), and our bespoke facial with locally sourced botanicals (75 min, $240). Shall I check availability for you?

amenities.name: High-Speed Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. Connect to 'Grand Aurel Guest' — no password required. Premium bandwidth for video calls and streaming is available at €18/day.

amenities.name: Dining & In-Room Dining
amenities.description: Our in-room dining is available 24 hours. Breakfast is served 6–11 AM, lunch 12–3 PM, and dinner from 6 PM through midnight. After midnight, our late-night menu features light fare and classic cocktails. For local dining, we recommend Maison Bleu on Rue Saint-Honoré (10-min walk, Michelin-starred seasonal tasting menu) or Café de Flore. We can make reservations on your behalf.

amenities.name: Airport Transfers & Chauffeur
amenities.description: We partner with Prestige Chauffeur for all transfers. A private sedan to Charles de Gaulle is €140 (45–60 min), and to Orly €115 (35–50 min). I can arrange pick-up for any time — please share your departure details.

amenities.name: Concierge Services
amenities.description: Our concierge team can arrange theatre tickets, private museum tours, curated shopping guides, florists, and last-minute reservations at the city's most sought-after restaurants (contact directly at ext. 0).

amenities.name: Valet Parking & EV Charging
amenities.description: Secure valet parking is available for $35 per overnight stay with unlimited in-and-out privileges. Complimentary Level 2 Tesla and universal EV charging stations are available for valet vehicles.

rooms.name: Deluxe King Room
rooms.description: Spacious 380 sq ft room featuring an ultra-comfortable plush King pillow-top bed, private balcony with garden views, marble walk-in rain shower, 55-inch smart 4K TV, and Nespresso machine.

rooms.name: Deluxe Double Queen Room
rooms.description: Generous 450 sq ft room designed for families or traveling groups of up to 4 guests (also ideal for 3 guests). Includes two plush Queen beds, spacious seating area, dual-sink vanity bathroom, and mini-refrigerator.

rooms.name: Executive Harbor Suite
rooms.bedConfig: 1 King Bed + 1 Queen Pullout Sofa Bed
rooms.description: Luxurious 620 sq ft suite featuring a separate master bedroom with 1 King bed and a living parlor with a premium Queen pullout sleeper sofa, comfortably accommodating 3 adult guests. Includes ocean/harbor views, deep soaking tub, complimentary daily breakfast, and late checkout priority.

rooms.name: Two-Bedroom Family Villa
rooms.bedConfig: 1 King Bed + 2 Twin Beds + 1 Queen Sleeper Sofa
rooms.description: Expansive 950 sq ft multi-room villa ideal for larger families and groups up to 6 guests. Features 2 private bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, fully-equipped kitchenette with dining area, private furnished ocean-facing patio, and complimentary daily breakfast.

faqs.question: What time is check-in and check-out?
faqs.answer: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM, and check-out is by 11:00 AM (standard check-out is at noon for Grand Aurel). Late check-out until 4 PM is available for $95, subject to availability — I can request that for your room right now if you'd like.

faqs.question: What is the check-out time?
faqs.answer: Standard check-out is at noon. Late check-out until 4 PM is available for $95, subject to availability — I can request that for your room right now if you'd like.

faqs.question: What are your room service hours and menu?
faqs.answer: Our in-room dining is available 24 hours. Breakfast is served 6–11 AM, lunch 12–3 PM, and dinner from 6 PM through midnight. After midnight, our late-night menu features light fare and classic cocktails. Shall I send the full menu to your room's tablet?

faqs.question: What spa treatments and appointments are available?
faqs.answer: The Aurel Spa is open daily from 8 AM to 9 PM. We offer signature treatments including the Grand Hammam ritual (90 min, $280), deep tissue massage (60 min, $195), and our bespoke facial with locally sourced botanicals (75 min, $240). Shall I check availability for you?

faqs.question: Can you recommend local dining?
faqs.answer: We recommend Maison Bleu on Rue Saint-Honoré — a 10-minute walk, Michelin-starred, stunning seasonal tasting menu. For something more relaxed, Café de Flore is nearby. I can make a reservation on your behalf — just let me know the time and party size.

faqs.question: Do you offer airport transportation or transfers?
faqs.answer: We partner with Prestige Chauffeur for all transfers. A private sedan to Charles de Gaulle is €140 (45–60 min), and to Orly €115 (35–50 min). I can arrange pick-up for any time — please share your departure details.

faqs.question: What concierge services do you provide?
faqs.answer: Our concierge team can arrange theatre tickets, private museum tours, curated shopping guides, florists, and last-minute reservations at the city's most sought-after restaurants. What can we arrange for you?

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: The heated rooftop infinity pool is open from 7 AM to 10 PM for guests. Cabanas may be reserved in advance. Poolside service for drinks and light bites runs 10 AM to 8 PM.

faqs.question: What are the fitness centre / gym hours and equipment?
faqs.answer: The fitness centre is open 24 hours with keycard access. It features Technogym equipment, a cycling studio, and Peloton bikes. Personal training sessions can be arranged at €120/hour.

faqs.question: How do I connect to Wi-Fi, and is premium bandwidth available?
faqs.answer: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. Connect to 'Grand Aurel Guest' — no password required. Premium bandwidth for video calls and streaming is available at €18/day.

faqs.question: When and where is breakfast served?
faqs.answer: Our breakfast buffet is served in the Grand Salon from 7 to 11 AM (weekends until 11:30 AM). Continental, cooked-to-order, and plant-based options are available. Room service breakfast begins at 6 AM.

faqs.question: Which room is suitable for three guests?
faqs.answer: For three guests, we recommend either the Executive Harbor Suite (1 King bed + 1 Queen pullout sofa bed, plus complimentary breakfast) or the Deluxe Double Queen Room (2 Queen beds, accommodating up to 4 guests comfortably).

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: You may cancel free of charge up to 48 hours prior to your scheduled check-in time (3:00 PM). Cancellations received within 48 hours of arrival will be charged the first night's room rate plus tax.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed at the hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes, we welcome up to two dogs per room under 25 lbs each. A non-refundable pet cleaning fee of $75 per stay applies. Certified service animals are always accommodated with no fee.

faqs.question: Is parking available, and how much does it cost?
faqs.answer: We offer secure valet parking for $35 per overnight stay with unlimited in-and-out privileges. Complimentary Level 2 Tesla and universal EV charging stations are available for valet vehicles.

faqs.question: Can I store my luggage before check-in or after check-out?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary secure luggage storage is available with our bell desk 24 hours a day, both before check-in and after check-out.

faqs.question: Is the hotel smoke-free?
faqs.answer: The hotel is a 100% non-smoking property. Smoking, including e-cigarettes and vaping, is strictly prohibited in all guest rooms, balconies, and indoor public spaces.

faqs.question: Are lunch and dinner included in the room rate or room budget?
faqs.answer: No, lunch and dinner are not included in the room rate or room budget. Guests can enjoy lunch and dinner à la carte at our dining venues or via 24-hour room service (breakfast 6–11 AM, lunch 12–3 PM, dinner 6 PM–midnight).
